title: OpenAI floats giving Trump administration 5 percent cut of AI boom
brief: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman proposed giving the U.S. government a 5 percent ownership stake, valued at roughly $42.6 billion based on the company's $852 billion valuation, as a means to reduce tensions with the Trump administration and address public concerns about AI concentration. Altman argued that public financial participation in AI's upside would be the best approach to wealth distribution from the technology's gains.
